policies.sweep20: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at20%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.cap40: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at40%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.active20: monthly closed source target contains positive non-BIL weight =>20% book share, otherwise zero; remainder reserve; explicit recapitalization when active
policies.scope: shares frozen at original monthly closed decision and filled after original delay; continuous cap not claimed; original source target stream unchanged; gross per-book fees including opposite fills
policies.profit: capital transfers sum zero and excluded from profit; three initial shares20/20/60; no new yield sources

dsr_pbo: not calculated; global trial count unreconciled; history consumed

selection_policy.primary: maximize minimum cash_excess_sharpe across all four cost/delay cells
selection_policy.ties: minimum CAGR, worst drawdown, lower maximum turnover, stable version ID

inverse_ETF_model: SH/PSQ/TBF actual adjusted open/close prices; long units of daily inverse funds, including embedded expenses and daily compounding; no synthetic minus-index returns
previously_consumed_later_data: Fifth-round July31..Sep30 equity and September crypto observations already inspected; no new independent later check in this round
missing_asset_policy: All ETH/PAXG segments resolved by decision-day available full history; never choose a latest future segment or fill gaps
fundamental_scope: No new source cashflow or fundamental claim; no funding, short, margin, borrowing or manufactured cash yield. Existing public sources remain frozen; forward windows not read.
stop_policy: One frozen study,8 new candidates/10 controls/72 curves; no return-conditioned rescue. Preserve failed implementation separately.
structural_question: Separate staged core/satellite acquisition ownership and measure causal daily actual source exposure ceilings against frozen monthly allocations.
accounting: Actual spot/fund units, owned vintage reductions and same-book BIL financing; gross independent book fees, no internal crossing discount; capital transfers sum zero and are not profit.

c60.asset: off-Sunday staged recovery/refill acquires only recovered or continuing assets; other assets receive owned vintage reductions only
c60.core: core-only transitions/refills acquire BTC/ETH family; any satellite trigger retains coupled full fill
c60.satellite: satellite-only transitions/refills acquire current/held satellite family; any core trigger retains coupled full fill
c60.family: single-family trigger/refill acquires that family; simultaneous core and satellite triggers retain coupled full fill
c60.staging: zero/absent prior nominal to positive; recovered assets half weight outside Sunday, next closed continuation refills; weekly Sunday full original targets
c60.reductions: scoped acquisition owns active-zone trades; complementary assets receive dated vintage reductions and nominal-zero exits; no duplicated asset sell/buy across both paths
c60.risk: 60-day covariance60% planned cap over combined active nominal plus min(current closed weight,nominal) for complement; shared actual cash and original lag; price/delay drift is not an actual hard volatility cap
c60.stale: cancel scoped/full positive acquisitions if latest closed nominal is zero; scopes include held missing family assets for explicit sale

g20.monthly: same tenth-round sweep20/cap40 monthly closed capital shares and funded gross source-book allocations; original source target stream unchanged
g20.daily: each close, equity_crisis and gold actual non-BIL invested dollars/global closed NAV above20%/40% generate proportional unit ceilings for that book
g20.fill: original T+1/T+2; source fill has priority and advances book epoch; stale epoch ceiling canceled; otherwise sell only excess over dated unit ceiling, finance actual BIL in same book including both trade fees
g20.ownership: repeated pending ceilings do not repeat an already-filled reduction; no risk-unit purchases or cross-book transfers from daily caps
g20.qualification: daily closed decisions are not a continuous hard exposure ceiling; actual ETF invested dollars are not look-through derivative leverage; report overshoots and source capital shares separately

failed_initial_run.reason: pre-start delayed monthly signal lacked all-cash allocation snapshot
